"""Independently inspect immutable V156 step500 without a neural call."""

from pathlib import Path

import torch
from review_local_risk_trial import equal_tree
from train_directional_bank_trial import guard, read, ref, save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261103/V156-local-risk-v1'
plan=read(root/'plan-v1.json');guard(plan)
assert read(root/'train-progress-v1.json')['step']>500
checkpoint=root/'checkpoints/train-step0500.pt'
previous=Path(plan['previous'])/'checkpoints/train-step0500.pt'
state=torch.load(checkpoint,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
old=torch.load(previous,map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
assert state['step']==old['step']==500
assert state['counts']==state['updates']=={'mse-control':500,'local-risk':500}
assert state['parent']==plan['parent']==old['parent']
assert set(state['models'])==set(state['emas'])==set(state['optimizers'])=={'mse-control','local-risk'}
for arm in state['models']:
    assert len(state['models'][arm])==len(state['emas'][arm])==len(state['optimizers'][arm]['state'])==13
    assert sum(v.numel() for v in state['models'][arm].values())==33713
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for k in ['models','emas'] for v in state[k][arm].values())
    assert all(float(s['step'])==500 for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values())
    assert all(torch.isfinite(v).all() for s in state['optimizers'][arm]['state'].values() for v in s.values())
for key in ['models','emas','optimizers']:
    assert equal_tree(state[key]['mse-control'],old[key]['mse-control']),key
assert not torch.cuda.is_initialized()
assert not (root/'checkpoint500-audit-v1.json').exists()
save(root/'checkpoint500-audit-v1.json',{
    'status':'pass-finite-two-head-state-and-exact-MSE-control-at500',
    'checkpoint':ref(checkpoint),'previous':ref(previous),'steps':500,
    'parameters_per_head':33713,'finite_Adam_states_at500':26,'control_raw_EMA_Adam_exact':True,
    'CUDA_initialized':False,'new_neural_calls':0,'new_parent_DINO_noise':0,
    'auditor':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'Immutable step500 engineering/state evidence only. Current production continues;final endpoint quality/native viewing remain unmeasured. Exact controls do not prove local-risk benefit or flat safety.'})
print('PASS step500:26 finite Adam states;MSE raw/EMA/Adam bit-exact V154;zero neural calls')
